title: Pickup areas and time profiles frontend adapter

input.requestedOutcome: Implement frontend migration packet C2 for pickup areas and time profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Hydrate pickup areas and profiles from operation-backend before Pickup Setup edits.
Use documented area, profile, cell, and resolve API contracts with server-first writes.
Preserve legacy mode and classic script ordering.
Add focused UI/API integration coverage without backend or DB changes.
allowedScope: the C2 classic script tag in allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html
constraints: Work only in D:/projects/wt-ops-pickup on agent/ops-pickup.
No backend, schema, migration, mapping, or database changes.
Use laOps/laOpsFetch, not direct operation-backend fetch calls.
Keep legacy mode unchanged and do not add async/module script attributes.
assumptions: Existing 00-ops-core.js and 01-auth-sync.js provide the authenticated operations client.

output.summary: Added an operations-mode pickup adapter with API hydration, server-first area/profile/cell CRUD, structured pickup text mapping, authoritative resolve, and focused real-backend browser coverage.

filesChanged.purpose: Maps pickup API resources to the legacy UI shape and wraps Pickup Setup writes only in operations mode.
Loads the C2 adapter as a classic script after deployments.
Exercises the frontend against the operation-backend in-process store.
Records scope, behavior, contracts, tests, risks, and rollback.

behaviorChanges.before: Operations mode used the browser's seeded/local pickup arrays.
behaviorChanges.after: Opening Pickup Setup loads active areas and full server profile cells before rendering.

behaviorChanges.before: Area/profile/time changes mutated local state and local persistence.
behaviorChanges.after: The API is called first; local projections change only after success and refresh.

behaviorChanges.before: Time cells were arbitrary legacy strings.
behaviorChanges.after: Supported strings map to server pickup fields, including pier deadlines; invalid strings visibly fail.

behaviorChanges.before: No operations-mode authoritative resolve client existed.
behaviorChanges.after: laOps.pickup.resolve calls /v1/pickup-time and propagates 404 without local fallback.

changed: Operations-mode wrappers for renderPickupSetup, psuSaveArea, psuDeleteArea, psuSetTimeCell, psuPersist, profile save/delete, and fallback profile resolution

details: Operations-mode pickup writes now use existing operation-backend endpoints.
API-derived pickup state is not written to the legacy localStorage blob.

verification.evidence: 12 focused browser/API assertions passed against the operation-backend in-process store.
3 backend pickup contract tests passed; backend checkout was read/test-only.
No whitespace errors in the owned diff.

decisions: Fetch profile details after the profile list because the list contract does not include cells.
Refresh after area/profile commands so server-side sibling inheritance is reflected locally.
Normalize only the documented HH:MM, HH:MM-HH:MM, and Before HH:MM at pier forms.
Keep shared 90-ops-boot.js untouched; Pickup Setup hydrates on entry before editing.
risks: Arbitrary legacy time text is no longer writable in operations mode; unsupported text is surfaced as a save error.
Hydrating profile cells makes one detail request per profile.
dependencies: Existing laOps core/auth client in allotment_v2/js/ops/00-ops-core.js and allotment_v2/js/01-auth-sync.js.
followUps: Coordinator may add the focused test to a package script if desired.
Shared boot-level pickup preloading can be considered later without changing this adapter contract.
rollback: Revert this commit; legacy mode remains on the original handlers and existing server pickup data is unaffected.
